title: Developer portal documentation
description:
Produce the public developer documentation for the ACME API.

The engagement is split into two milestones: written documentation first, then the packaged release. Each milestone has its own frozen acceptance criteria and its own evaluation.

Evaluation is performed by GenLayer validators against a public HTTPS evidence URL submitted by the worker.

milestones.title: API documentation
criteria: The evidence documents a GET /users endpoint
The evidence documents the response payload fields
The evidence states the measured test coverage

milestones.title: Release packaging
criteria: The evidence references a public deployment URL
The evidence declares a signed release tag
